sql: select v.version, r.verdict, left(r.metrics_json::text,600) as metrics, r.computed_at::text as computed, (select count(*) from paper_trades where strategy='mmsell10' and created_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-02 08:25:39+00' and status in ('settled','closed_sl','closed_tp','closed_timeout')) as settled_v3, (select count(*) from paper_trades where strategy='mmsell10' and created_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-02 08:25:39+00') as created_v3, (select count(*) from mmsell_candidate_ticks where captured_at > now() - interval '10 minutes') as cands_10m, now()::text as now_utc from experiment_versions v join experiment_gates g on g.version_id=v.id left join experiment_gate_results r on r.gate_id=g.id and r.id=(select max(id) from experiment_gate_results r2 where r2.gate_id=g.id) where v.experiment_id=(select id from experiments where key='mmsell-price-ceiling-capacity') and g.gate_key='paper_to_live_canary' order by v.version desc limit 1
